description: List the 50 most recently updated files in a Files surface, sorted by `updatedAt` descending. Flat surface-wide list; ignores folder structure. Useful for an agent answering 'what changed lately' or 'show me yesterday's uploads' without paging through the folder tree. Folders are omitted from this view.

slug.description: The workspace slug. Accepts either the bare slug or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/my-workspace') as shown in the dashboard URL.

surface_slug.description: Files-kind surface slug within the workspace.

name: list_recent_files
